page.overview:
What is Ford?

The Ford licensing relationship with The LEGO Group has a long and varied history, spanning three distinct phases. The license was first introduced in 1961 as a sub-theme of the HO 1:87 Vehicles line, featuring sets such as the 263 Ford Taunus de Luxe with Garage. Following a significant gap, the Ford license was reintroduced much later in 2016 under the Speed Champions theme, marked by the release of sets like 75871 Ford Mustang GT and 75875 Ford F-150 Raptor & Ford Model A Hot Rod. Today, Ford remains a continuously licensed sub-theme, primarily integrated within the Speed Champions and TECHNIC themes.
